description: Codex classifies the open-standard `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` as `codex`/`skill` alongside its `.codex/agents/*.toml` sub-agents, via manifest composition of the `agent-skills` open-standard pieces over a multi-rule `read` (TOML agents + Markdown skills). The fixture carries BOTH a `.codex/` and a `.agents/` marker, so the lens is pinned to `codex` in `.skill-map/settings.json` (no auto-detect ambiguity). Three nodes (one agent, one skill, AGENTS.md via the `core/markdown` fallback) and no issues: codex claims the skill path so `core/markdown` disclaims it, no `provider-ambiguous`. Two resolved links exercise the resolution matrix end to end: the agent's `/run-tests` resolves to the skill (`invokes` -> `skill`) and the skill's `@builder` resolves to the agent (`mentions` -> `agent`).
